editorial.blurb: Tango Sur is an intimate, candlelit Argentine steakhouse where tender cuts and vibrant chimichurri sauce shine alongside creative appetizers and genuine hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead to book—waits can stretch an hour during peak dinner times. This is a BYOB spot, and there's a local pantry store two doors down for wine selections.

topDishes.note: Impossibly tender flap meat with a deep, savory caper-white wine vesuvio sauce
Loaded and packed with flavor, served with an addictively refreshing chimichurri sauce
Roasted cheese with a nice red pepper touch—a can't-miss starter
